action.new:
Exception raised when a continuation line (a non-blank, non-comment
   line whose indentation is greater than that of the preceding option)
   follows an option that has no value.  This condition is only possible
   when the ``allow_no_value`` constructor option is ``True``.  Subclass
   of :exc:`ParsingError`.
action.old:
Exception raised when a continuation line (a line beginning with
   whitespace) follows an option that has no value.  This condition is
   only possible when :attr:`!allow_no_value` is ``True``.  Subclass of
   :exc:`ParsingError`.
